theorem probe_nv_strategy :
    ∃ G : QuantumParallelRepetition.Game Unit Unit Unit Unit,
      Nonempty (QuantumParallelRepetition.Strategy G) := by
  let G : QuantumParallelRepetition.Game Unit Unit Unit Unit :=
    { questionWeight := fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)
      weight_nonneg := fun _ _ => zero_le_one
      weight_normalized := by simp
      predicate := fun _ _ _ _ => true }
  have hpos : (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℂ).PosSemidef := Matrix.PosSemidef.one
  have hposp : (1 : Matrix (Unit × Unit) (Unit × Unit) ℂ).PosSemidef := Matrix.PosSemidef.one
  let P : QuantumParallelRepetition.POVM Unit Unit :=
    { effect := fun _ => (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℂ)
      positive := fun _ => hpos
      complete := by simp }
  let ρ : QuantumParallelRepetition.DensityMatrix (Unit × Unit) :=
    { matrix := (1 : Matrix (Unit × Unit) (Unit × Unit) ℂ)
      positive := hposp
      trace_one := by simp }
  refine ⟨G, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact
    { Alice := Unit
      Bob := Unit
      state := ρ
      aliceMeasurement := fun _ => P
      bobMeasurement := fun _ => P }
